wave.summary: Provisioned an isolated worktree/branch derived from /Users/truman/Projects/prompt-spark (both derivation asserts passed: git-common-dir resolved into the target's .git, .swarm/SPEC.md present). Read the frozen src/core/types.ts contract (Subject, Difficulty, Filters). Implemented src/core/share.ts: pure module (no DOM/window), encodeShare({seed, filters}) builds a URLSearchParams-style query string (e.g. 'seed=123&subject=law&difficulty=easy'), omitting absent filter keys entirely. decodeShare(qs) parses back to {seed, filters} | null: returns null on missing/empty seed, non-integer seed (regex + Number.isSafeInteger check), or on an unknown subject/difficulty value — chosen behavior is outright rejection (null) rather than silent stripping, and this choice is documented in comments and covered by dedicated tests. Wrote src/core/share.test.ts (vitest) with 18 cases: roundtrip equality for empty/subject-only/difficulty-only/both-filters states, roundtrip for every individual subject and difficulty enum value, zero and negative seeds, an explicit encodeShare format check, and malformed/unknown-enum inputs all returning null. Needed to run `npm ci` first since the worktree had no node_modules (fresh worktree, gitignored dir) — verified package-lock.json's checksum was unchanged before and after, so no manifest/lockfile was touched. Also ran `npx tsc -b` to typecheck (clean, exit 0) but reverted the two tracked .tsbuild/*.tsbuildinfo cache files it touched as a side effect, since they're outside my file scope. Committed only src/core/share.ts and src/core/share.test.ts on branch wave-300400-T-008; working tree is otherwise clean.
